title: Copying an input prefix
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, every natural number $j$, and every $j\le |x|$, after $j$ steps the raw strip machine started on $x$ is in state $0$, its input head is at position $j+1$, its work tape contains the prefix of $x$ of length $j$, its work head is at position $j$, and its output is empty.
